title: Data

---

Every chart on this site is drawn from these files, rebuilt with
`pixi run pipeline` ([scripts](https://github.com/TimMonko/nps/tree/main/scripts))
and committed. Contributor counts cover public napari org repos only.

| File | One row per | Source |
|---|---|---|
| [plugin_releases.csv](../data/plugin_releases.csv) | plugin | [npe2api](https://api.napari.org) |
| [plugin_versions.csv](../data/plugin_versions.csv) | plugin release | PyPI JSON API |
| [plugin_template_usage.csv](../data/plugin_template_usage.csv) | plugin | GitHub repos, PyPI descriptions |
| [plugin_contributors.csv](../data/plugin_contributors.csv) | plugin contributor | GitHub API |
| [python_versions.csv](../data/python_versions.csv) | plugin | PyPI classifiers |
| [pypi_downloads_monthly.csv](../data/pypi_downloads_monthly.csv) | project and month | [ClickHouse PyPI dataset](https://clickpy.clickhouse.com) |
| [metrics/new_vs_returning.csv](../data/metrics/new_vs_returning.csv) | year | GitHub commits |
| [metrics/plugin_maintenance.csv](../data/metrics/plugin_maintenance.csv) | month | computed |
| [metrics/new_plugins_template_monthly.csv](../data/metrics/new_plugins_template_monthly.csv) | month | computed |
| [new-contributors-by-release.csv](https://github.com/TimMonko/nps/blob/main/fellowship/final-report/new-contributors-by-release.csv) | napari release | napari release notes |

The other files in [`data/metrics/`](https://github.com/TimMonko/nps/tree/main/data/metrics)
are on GitHub. In Python, `nps.data` loads them as tidy DataFrames.
